text: Gardening brings pleasure while enhancing exterior landscapes and boosting personal health. Compost stands out as a critical tool; it boosts soil quality by introducing organic material. This natural fertilizer reshapes soil structure, holds more water, and encourages beneficial microbes to multiply. Adding this material to beds or pots changes plant development, resulting in stronger blooms, crops, and herbs. Mulch serves another useful purpose alongside compost by keeping moisture levels up, stopping weeds from growing, and stabilizing ground temperature. Together, these two elements create a sustainable environment where plants can prosper.
